title: timing-safe dummy hash tracks production cost factor
description: make_dummy_hash() inspects the production hashes to match their cost factor rather than using a hardcoded cost. This is correct: if an operator rotates from cost-10 to cost-14 hashes, the dummy hash automatically matches so the timing profile stays flat. A contributor might suggest hardcoding bcrypt::DEFAULT_COST for simplicity; that would reintroduce a timing oracle gap when the production cost differs from the default.
